episodes.title: SHAKAHOLA CASE: COURT DECLARES MACKENZIE’S MINISTRY A CULT
episodes.description:
Justice Diana Kavedza-Mochache has declared Paul Mackenzie’s Good News International Ministries a cult while delivering judgment in the Shakahola murder case at Mombasa High Court.
